title: My Favourite Food
description: A child talks about making and eating pizza with grandma.
instructions: Read the text about a favourite food, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: My favourite food is pizza. I like pizza with cheese and tomatoes. I do not like pizza with fish.
Every Saturday, my grandma makes pizza at home. I help her. I put the cheese on top. The kitchen smells delicious.
We eat the pizza in the garden. My grandpa drinks orange juice with it. I always eat three pieces. After that, I am very full.

Grandma makes the pizza from the start. First, she mixes flour, water and salt. Then she makes it flat and round. She puts tomato sauce on it. Then I add the cheese. The pizza goes in the hot oven for fifteen minutes.

My little brother, Tom, does not like tomatoes. So Grandma makes a small pizza only for him. It has cheese and ham on it. Tom is five years old. He eats very slowly and talks a lot. Sometimes he gives his ham to me!

Sometimes we eat pizza at a restaurant in town. It is called Luigi's. We go there on my birthday. The pizzas there are very big. But I think Grandma's pizza is better. It is hot, fresh and made with love.
I also like other food. I like rice, chicken and apples. But I do not like carrots. My mum says, 'Carrots are good for you!' I eat them, but pizza is still my favourite food.
